metadata.name: Lake Sediment Core Geochemical Record from Central Germany
metadata.description: Geochemical and physical analysis of lake sediment core samples collected from a single location in central Germany (near Leipzig). The dataset contains 21 samples with measurements of organic and inorganic geochemistry (TOC, BC, CaCO3, TP, S, trace metals Pb/Zn/Cu), stable isotope ratios (δ13C, δ15N), grain size distribution, magnetic properties, and derived elemental ratios (S/V, C/V). Samples were collected during two field campaigns in 2018 and 2019.
